payload.title: Deployable kanbus-api artifact: published Lambda zip and CDK construct with per-environment layout
payload.description: Chatticus will deploy Kanbus-shipped kanbus-api per environment. Today it is unpublished; consumers pin a Kanbus commit and build kanbus-api-lambda themselves (services/kanbus-api/AMPLIFY.md), and the AWS resources are described as a table, not a construct. Ship: a versioned Lambda zip attached to Kanbus releases (x86_64 musl, PROVIDED_AL2023) and a CDK construct (bucket, catalog table with GSIs, Lambda, HTTP API) parameterized by environment name, with documented per-environment bucket and table naming. Release through CI only.
